title: Sneakers Painting Class in Celebration Town
includes: All supplies included- canvas sneakers (Slip-ons), paints, brushes, aprons and water cups
PLEASE TEXT YOUR NAME/SNEAKER SIZE (No half sizes) RIGHT AFTER BOOKING.
High-Top Sneakers available upon request for an additional fee ($15/pair) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Looking for something fun to do in Orlando outside of theme parks? Why not explore Celebration and try a painting class? But this isn't your average paint night. Join us in this fun sneakers painting class.
